_about: Operator-owned DeepSeek list prices in USD per million tokens, used to ESTIMATE spend from the [usage] log lines. Edit when DeepSeek changes prices: add a new entry with its validFrom date and keep the old one. A usage day older than every validFrom is priced with the earliest entry (an estimate at that rate, not the rate in force then).

peak.note: Peak is 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays. Off-peak is half the peak rate. Holidays are not modelled, so those days are estimated at the peak rate: an upper bound.
